Balikatan drills

Military forces from the Philippines, the United States, and Japan conduct high-intensity Counter-Landing Live Fire Exercise on May 4, 2026, at the La Paz Sand Dunes in Laoag, Ilocos Norte. The joint maneuvers, featured a massive display of integrated firepower including HIMARS rocket systems, Apache Longbow attack helicopters, and 105mm howitzers.

VIDEO BY J. GERARD SEGUIA
